ideas.pitch: A privacy-preserving identity verifier using zero-knowledge proofs and the Arkiv Web3 database designed for Indian use cases.
ideas.problem_statement: Best Indian Use Case: A real-world application built on Arkiv that people in India can use.
ideas.title: AadhaarVerify-Arkiv
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the $2,000 USDC Best Indian Use Case track directly with a localized real-world application that leverages ZK data patterns seen in winning projects like fact-fortress-dapp.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized transaction and data indexer on Arkiv that detects and flags front-running and state censorship attempts on Ethereum rollups.
ideas.problem_statement: Censorship Resistance (Global): Build a tool promoting censorship resistance on Arkiv.
ideas.title: CensorShield Indexer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific CROPS mandate for censorship resistance, appealing directly to judges looking for robust infrastructure rather than a generic dApp.

ideas.pitch: An open-source package and dependency registry built entirely on top of the Arkiv database to ensure immutable and verifiable package states.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Source (Global): Build open-source utilities or libraries leveraging the Arkiv database.
ideas.title: OpenArkiv Registry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Open Source global track by offering a critical developer tool utilizing the official npm package @arkiv-network/sdk.

ideas.pitch: A private data locker leveraging ZK proofs stored on Arkiv, allowing users to share encrypted metadata without exposing plaintext inputs.
ideas.problem_statement: Privacy (Global): Build applications or protocols upholding the Privacy pillar of CROPS on Arkiv.
ideas.title: ZK-Vault Arkiv
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced cryptographic privacy mechanics with hard engineering as demonstrated by winning privacy-focused projects like will-wallet-leading-privacy.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent audit trail and security monitor that writes state execution logs directly to Arkiv to prevent malicious agent tampering.
ideas.problem_statement: Security (Global): Build security infrastructure on Arkiv to maintain safety and integrity.
ideas.title: SecureAgent Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ties into the high-performing AI agent trust architecture pattern from triage-hackathon while focusing specifically on the Security global track.
